'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[Mariupol]] City Council claims that over 10,000 of the city's residents are being held prisoner by the [[separatist]] [[Donetsk People's Republic]]. [https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/843220.html (UkInterfax)]
***[[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] claims that his country intercepted Ukrainian missiles directed at [[Belarus]] three days ago and says that Belarus "does not want war with [[Ukraine]]". [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/07/02/lukashenko-reportedly-says-belarus-intercepted-attempted-missile-strikes-by-ukraine.html (CNBC)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**At least 30 people are killed in an [[ambush]] in [[Shiroro]], [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-30-nigerian-soldiers-killed-ambush-after-mine-attack-sources-2022-07-02/ (Reuters)]
*The Israeli Navy intercepts three [[Hezbollah]] drones from [[Lebanon]] in Israeli airspace. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-711021 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Bonnie (2022)|Tropical Storm Bonnie]]
***Tropical Storm Bonnie makes landfall near the [[Costa Rica–Nicaragua border]]. The storm subsequently crosses over from the Atlantic basin to the Pacific basin, becoming the first storm to do so since [[Hurricane Otto]] in 2016. One person is reported missing in [[Trinidad and Tobago]]. [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2022/al02/al022022.discus.018.shtml? (National Hurricane Center)] [https://newsday.co.tt/2022/06/29/search-for-body-in-cumaca-cut-short-by-river-terrain/ (''Newsday'')]
**[[Tropical Storm Colin (2022)|Tropical Storm Colin]] makes landfall in [[South Carolina]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-storms-hurricanes-nicaragua-tropical-72aec05a201884670b6c921fea48df9e (AP)]
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[2022 Pacific typhoon season#Typhoon Chaba (Caloy)|Typhoon Chaba]]
***Typhoon Chaba, also known as Typhoon Caloy, makes landfall in [[Guangdong]], China, as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|category one]] typhoon. [https://news.cgtn.com/news/2022-07-02/Typhoon-Chaba-lands-in-South-China-s-Guangdong--1bl5jwXQV7q/index.html (CGTN)]
***More than two dozen people are missing after an engineering vessel sinks off the coast of Hong Kong during the storm. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/over-two-dozen-crew-missing-storm-chaba-hits-hong-kong-2022-07-02/ (Reuters)]

***The [[World Health Organization]] announces that European cases of [[monkeypox]] have tripled in the past two weeks. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/07/01/who-says-monkeypox-cases-triple-in-europe-in-two-weeks-urgent-action-needed-to-contain-spread.html (CNBC)]
***[[Andorra]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2022/07/02/primer_cas_verola_del_mico_203406_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Karakalpak protests]]
**The government of [[Uzbekistan]] drops plans to strip [[Karakalpakstan]] of its autonomy amid widespread protests in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/protests-break-out-uzbek-autonomous-region-over-constitution-reform-plan-2022-07-02/ (Reuters)]
**[[Internet]] access is restricted in Uzbekistan as regional protests continue for a second day, with the government accusing a "criminal gang" of trying to seize government buildings in Karakalpakstan.
